## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run pytest packages/shared/tests packages/knowledge/tests packages/core/tests packages/agent/tests` passa
- [ ] `uv run ruff check packages/` limpo
- [ ] Nenhuma credencial (API key, token OAuth, `client_secret.json`) neste diff
- [ ] Nenhum dado real de canal (performance, padrões, exemplos ingeridos, hashtags específicas) — só `niches/example-niche/` fictício
- [ ] Commits seguem Conventional Commits (`feat(pacote): ...`, `fix(pacote): ...`, `docs: ...`, `chore: ...`)
